title: Perfect core of a field of positive characteristic
statement: Let $p$ be prime and $K$ a field of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-field]. The perfect core of $K$ is the subfield $K_{\mathrm{perf}}=\bigcap_{n\geq0}\{y^{p^n}:y\in K\}$, the intersection of the images of all iterates of Frobenius.

source.place: Expose IV, section 3.2.1, printed p. 55: maximal perfect subfield as the intersection of all Frobenius images.
